provenance.policy: Three distinct unchanged camera originals. No metadata stripping, crop, redaction, resize, synthetic noise or repeated source. Selected originals must be tracked and included in the benchmark commit before acceptance use.

scene: Carpet fibers beside blank paper, with a narrow defocused dark upper background strip containing unidentifiable generic shapes. No identifiable room detail is inferred.

comparisonLimits: ISO400 uses 1/15s; ISO6400 uses 1/250s; ISO12800 uses 1/500s. ISO times exposure differs by about 0.059EV between lower/higher ISO shots.
ISO400 recorded WB gains differ slightly from the matching ISO6400/12800 gains. AF-S does not prove unchanged focus, and registration/illumination stability have not been measured.
This is an approximately exposure-matched photographic comparison, not a calibrated noiseless ground-truth pair, automatic burst or radiometric reference.

privacyReview.scope: Repository privacy inspection only, not application/denoising/quality acceptance
privacyReview.visualReview: Every extracted PreviewImage and ThumbnailImage and every whole native 5496x3672 scene were viewed. Parent independently reviewed all three complete native scenes.
privacyReview.findings: No identifiable people, readable labels/addresses/plates, personal document or screen content, or identifying private-interior details observed. The narrow defocused upper background strip was explicitly reviewed; no original was sanitized.
privacyReview.metadataTool: ExifTool 13.59, read-only -j -n -a -u -G1 -s including interpreted and unknown tags; 2139 tags per file.
